hypotheses.name: Displaced potential-field piercing markers
hypotheses.layers: Cached RTP/TMI and isostatic-gravity anomaly bands; independent LiDAR strike/validity only as a support check.
hypotheses.signature: Local patch registration on opposite sides of a candidate corridor: require a coherent lateral offset of at least two marker ridges, with a consistent offset direction and a fault-like boundary between them. The corridor, not the displaced lithologic markers, receives support.
hypotheses.missing_fault_rationale: A fault may displace pre-existing magnetic/density contacts even where it lacks a mapped Quaternary surface scarp. No catalogue-tip interpolation or copied champion dots are used.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: No marker-pair displacement/patch-registration transform was found in the reviewed local modules. This is not Euler depth estimation, upward-continuation edge migration, ordinary edge co-location, or a catalogue gap bridge.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Intrusive cross-cutting contacts, branching lithologic contacts, or survey-registration seams.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement: Highest qualitative information potential in this slate; unmeasured, not a score or numerical projection.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium to high; correspondence and seam controls are essential.
hypotheses.availability: Computationally testable using the hash-verified restored cache. Official source authenticity/metadata remain distinct from mirror integrity.
hypotheses.status: Proposed only; no assigned lane, no implementation or holdout run. Global cross-repository novelty is not established.

hypotheses.name: Lithology-conditioned uranium/thorium transport dipoles
hypotheses.layers: Restored GeoDAWN U, Th and K rasters and the UTh ratio cache, with gravity-edge orientation as an independent geometric reference.
hypotheses.signature: An odd-symmetric, cross-corridor U/Th residual after conditioning on local Th and K, persisting along strike while bulk lithologic contrast is weak. Explicitly test missingness and quantization as separate canaries.
hypotheses.missing_fault_rationale: Fluid/redox transport along a concealed permeable boundary could change mobile uranium relative to thorium without a preserved topographic scarp. This is a testable conjecture, not a geothermal diagnostic.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: Existing radiometry/alteration arms use channel values, ratios or ridge conjunctions; this proposal tests signed dipole morphology and a lithology-conditioned residual. It does not reuse the GEMSDOE24 magnetic-trough/ThK-depletion arm.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Groundwater redox fronts, surficial sediment sorting, radon disequilibrium, or airborne survey artifacts.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement: Moderate qualitative potential, high physical ambiguity; unmeasured and not a score.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium; quantized cache cannot support absolute geochemical calibration.
hypotheses.availability: U/Th/K and ratio-cache bytes and band descriptions are locally verified. No new external data needed for an internal diagnostic; official-source provenance remains unverified here.
hypotheses.status: Proposed only; no assigned lane, no implementation or holdout run.

hypotheses.name: Paired-geothermometer cooling corridors
hypotheses.layers: Restored GDR #1391 well/spring coordinates, measured temperature and paired quartz/chalcedony geothermometer fields; independent gravity/magnetic geometry.
hypotheses.signature: Deduplicate sites and analyze spatially persistent differences among reservoir-temperature estimates and measured temperature. Test an elongated, multi-site cooling/disequilibrium corridor rather than a circular distance-to-hot-spring surface. Never read dist_known_fault_px.
hypotheses.missing_fault_rationale: A connected upflow/discharge route may lack a mapped surface rupture; differential cooling along a route could supply evidence not present in a single high-temperature threshold.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: thermal.py reduces geothermometers by their maximum and thresholds near-site distances. This proposal retains paired differences and site-to-site directional structure; it is not the earlier thermal-vent/spring halo addition.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Groundwater mixing, incomplete mineral equilibration, drilling/production effects, or preferential sampling.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement: Low to moderate qualitative potential; sparse and biased observations limit transfer. No numerical gain is claimed.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium; require paired measurements and multi-site support, not imputed chemistry.
hypotheses.availability: The restored table contains paired finite quartz/chalcedony fields, but raw rows are not independent sites. The proposal must deduplicate before fitting and pass a site-density canary.
hypotheses.status: Proposed only; no assigned lane, no implementation or holdout run.

hypotheses.name: Opposite-flank flexural curvature pairs
hypotheses.layers: Cached detrended elevation, LiDAR upface/downface/relief/strike/validity descriptors and long-wavelength isostatic-gravity geometry.
hypotheses.signature: Require an ordered, signed pair of broad curvature lobes on opposite sides of a corridor and consistent relief asymmetry, rather than simply taking a gradient or curvature maximum. Separate broad warping from a sharp scarp response.
hypotheses.missing_fault_rationale: Distributed flexure above a buried normal fault may survive where there is no sharp catalogue-mapped surface break. This does not infer fault dip or slip from scalar fields alone.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: Existing gravity-bench/structural-step modules use gradient strength, local relief or curvature magnitude; no opposite-flank ordered-pair test was found in the local implementation.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Alluvial-fan margins, paleoshorelines, differential compaction, lithology-controlled erosion or data seams.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement: Lowest qualitative priority in this slate because nontectonic landforms can be abundant; unmeasured, not a score.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium with the existing coarse/cache bands; detailed confirmation would require official 3DEP tiles.
hypotheses.availability: A coarse internal diagnostic is computationally available. High-resolution confirmation is NOT currently viable: official USGS 3DEP tiles were not downloaded/coverage-verified in this runtime, so no high-resolution result is proposed as ready.
hypotheses.status: Proposed only; no assigned lane, no implementation or holdout run.
